items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

ctx.x: 881 Club. On LaCienega Blvd. And word got around and all of a sudden Mitzi Gaynor’s coming in, Cary Grant is coming in, Ray Milland is coming in, and everybody is coming in and we’re doing great business and it was wonderful.
